name: otel-mcp-fixture-generator
description: Deterministic OTLP/JSON fixture generator using official OpenTelemetry SDK

scripts.preinstall: node -e "var v=process.versions.node;var e=require('fs').readFileSync(require('path').join(__dirname,'.node-version'),'utf8').trim();if(v!==e){console.error('FAIL: Node '+v+' does not match .node-version '+e);process.exit(1)}"
